notes: DeepFlux 7.6 - redesigned navigation: one-click tab icons in the menu bar; browser tabs shrink to fit instead of stretching the window; right-click any bookmark or folder to delete it (folders take their bookmarks with them, and the bookmarks menu stays open and updates on the spot); the browser toolbar lingers 2 seconds before hiding; stability fixes (the background hardware monitor strip is removed) and tools now run without confirmation pop-ups by default (YOLO mode, toggle next to the agent input).
